entries.title: Jeremiah 10:1
segments: ¶Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:2
segments: Thus saith the LORD, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:3
segments: For the customs of the people [are] vain: for [one] cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe. {customs...: Heb. statutes, or, ordinances are vanity}

words.text: . {customs...: Heb. statutes, or, ordinances are vanity}

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:4
segments: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:5
segments: They [are] upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also [is it] in them to do good.

words.text: of them; for they cannot do evil
, neither also [is it] in them to do good

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:6
segments: Forasmuch as [there is] none like unto thee, O LORD; thou [art] great, and thy name [is] great in might.

words.text: Forasmuch as [there is] none like unto thee, O LORD

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:7
segments: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise [men] of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, [there is] none like unto thee. {to...: or, it liketh thee}

words.text: ? for to thee doth it appertain
: forasmuch as among all the wise
, [there is] none like unto thee. {to...: or, it liketh thee}

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:8
segments: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock [is] a doctrine of vanities. {altogether: Heb. in one, or, at once}

words.text: . {altogether: Heb. in one, or, at once}

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:9
segments: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple [is] their clothing: they [are] all the work of cunning [men].

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:10
segments: But the LORD [is] the true God, he [is] the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation. {true...: Heb. God of truth} {everlasting...: Heb. king of eternity}

words.text: shall not be able to abide
. {true...: Heb. God of truth} {everlasting...: Heb. king of eternity}

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:11
segments: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, [even] they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:12
segments: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:13
segments: When he uttereth his voice, [there is] a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures. {multitude: or, noise} {with: or, for}

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:14
segments: Every man is brutish in [his] knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image [is] falsehood, and [there is] no breath in them. {brutish in his knowledge: or, more brutish than to know}

words.text: in them. {brutish in his knowledge: or, more brutish than to know}

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:15
segments: They [are] vanity, [and] the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:16
segments: The portion of Jacob [is] not like them: for he [is] the former of all [things]; and Israel [is] the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts [is] his name.

words.text: [is] not like them: for he [is] the former

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:17
segments: ¶Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress. {inhabitant: Heb. inhabitress}

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:18
segments: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find [it so].

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:19
segments: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this [is] a grief, and I must bear it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:20
segments: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they [are] not: [there is] none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

words.text: of me, and they [are] not: [there is] none to stretch forth
any more, and to set up

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:21
segments: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:22
segments: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, [and] a den of dragons.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:23
segments: O LORD, I know that the way of man [is] not in himself: [it is] not in man that walketh to direct his steps.

words.text: [is] not in himself: [it is] not in man

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:24
segments: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing. {bring...: Heb. diminish me}

words.text: , lest thou bring me to nothing

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:25
segments: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
